fixed.problem: Blocking finding (L4-github-104): the item was claimed fixed, but no test checked what the person sees. The only test asserted the stored card field change_card.proposal.docs. fixed.problem: Non-blocking finding from the review (fixed because it is in this area's new code and is a real failure): intakeDocsBranch (new in L4-github-111) kept dots from the project's name. 'Wait... what' gave fr/intake-<8>-wait...-what-docs, which git refuses ('..'), so an approved first plan's docs pull request could not be pushed for such a name. Root cause: intake.ts intakeDocsBranch used safeSegment, which allows dots. scaffoldBranchesOf already replaces them.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/intake.test.ts "the docs branch of a name with dots is one git accepts: dots become dashes, as the scaffold's branch does (review of L4-github-111)". Before the fix: "expected 'fr/intake-f66a6f86-wait...-what-docs' to be 'fr/intake-f66a6f86-wait--what-docs'". The test also runs git check-ref-format --branch on five names.
fixed.how: packages/runtime/src/session/intake.ts intakeDocsBranch turns the name's dots into dashes, as scaffoldBranchesOf does. The L4-github-111 form is new on this branch, so no existing branch name changes. runtime.md says so. User guide (same commit): the take-over's no-pull-request line said it shows 'until that pull request is on GitHub'. In fact it reads only the scaffold's record and this computer's copy of the default branch, and nothing tries the pull request again. It now says what ends the line: a merged pull request that puts the project in .forerunner/project.json, or the Undo on Changes.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Not visible on its own. live_check (real GitHub, forerunner-sandbox): New project named 'Wait... what' with a brief on a repository > approve the plan > GitHub shows the docs pull request from fr/intake-<8 characters>-wait--what-docs.

new_problems: Sibling of the intake branch fix, in l4-github-merge's PR executor (not touched): packages/capabilities/src/githost/pr-executor.ts:519 taskBranchName keeps dots from a task's title. 'Update yarn.lock' gives fr/<8>-update-yarn.lock and 'Wait... what' gives fr/<8>-wait...-what. git check-ref-format --branch refuses both (checked here), so such a task's branch cannot be made or pushed. The fix is the same: turn dots into dashes, as scaffoldBranchesOf and now intakeDocsBranch do.

Still to make sure at the L4e merge (the reviewer's note, seen again on this bench): packages/runtime/src/daemon/pull-requests.ts:72 docsTitle recognises only DOCS_SCAFFOLD_BRANCH, so the take-over's docs PR on fr/docs-scaffold-<slug> shows on the Overview as '"The project's docs from the plan" · pull request #2' although there was no plan. l4-github-merge owns that file and should use isScaffoldBranch (exported from loop/docs.ts by this area). Evidence: /tmp/frbench/fixup-l4-github-link-evidence/02-rv-a2-overview.png.

Carried from the fixer and the review, unchanged: a GitHub Enterprise install still accepts github.com links (repoHostsFor's default gitRemoteBase); the fake daemon's data import mirrors only the in-use refusal, not other_host; join-words.ts settingAppliesLine's possessive after a quoted name (L4-github-113, l4-github-merge; drop the writing-rules sweep's exclusion once it is fixed); rebuildForTakeOver can replace main's newer version of a file the scaffold branch also changed; after Undo of a successful take-over its docs PR stays open on GitHub (run C decision 14); two concurrent first-plan POSTs are not refused atomically; the offer's first sentence cuts the marker name at 60 characters mid-word (markerNameOf, older code).
notes_for_other_areas: apps/ui/src/pages/InboxPage.tsx exports intakeDecisionLine(card: IntakeCardView): string | null. It returns the plan card's 'Decision: ...' line exactly as rendered (data-testid intake-decision-line), or null for a plan-only card or a record without a decision. Real-daemon tests should read the daemon's card through it, as they do with intakeTotalLine.

Bench stand-in: FORERUNNER_BENCH_INTAKE_BAD=no-docs (testenv/src/bench/role-player.ts INTAKE_BAD_KINDS) makes the first reply of each draft a plan with no docs key. A first plan is then asked once more (MISSING_DECISION_PROBLEM) and gets the plan with its decision record; a plan-only (Add to it) reply is taken at once.
The real-daemon describe 'l4-github-link, run L4' world().compose now takes the stand-in's knobs: compose({ FORERUNNER_BENCH_INTAKE_BAD: 'no-docs' }). Called with no argument it behaves as before.

intakeDocsBranch now turns the project name's dots into dashes (fr/intake-<8>-wait--what-docs), like scaffoldBranchesOf. taskBranchName (l4-github-merge's PR executor) should get the same rule (see new_problems).
